correctness.rationale: The full 12-state subset transition table follows by checking the eight three-bit majority outputs. Pair-state comparison has exact cardinalities 110,40,24,12,8,4,0 and proves six-symbol suffix synchronization. The six minimal forbidden words are exhaustively obtained at lengths \(\le 7\); synchronization proves that this is the complete unbounded language. The nonnegative 11-state matrix satisfies \((M^5-2M^4+M^2-I)\mathbf 1=-e_{15}\); since state 15 has no incoming arcs this yields the order-five recurrence for all \(n\ge1\). Its exact characteristic polynomial \(t(t^5+t^2-1)(t^5-2t^4+t^2-1)\), plus Perron theory and Descartes rule, gives the unique entropy root larger than one. Code replays all critical finite certificates; infinite claims rest on proved induction and matrix arguments.
